TOYOTA C-HR
ALL- NEW

EVERY 
CHOICE 
COUNTS
Express yourself with the All-New 
Toyota C-HR. Daring to be different 
with a unique design, the Toyota 
C-HR was inspired by the mould 
breaking original and goes against 
all the rules.

MOULD-
BREAKING 
EXTERIOR 
DESIGN 
The All-New Toyota C-HR has a powerful and stylish 
presence that can’t be ignored. It is a concept car made 
real, and is sure to turn heads with its sharp lines and 
a standout profile. The Toyota C-HR does anything but 
blend in.  
TRI-FOLD EXECUTION
Precision-cut lines define the powerful, 
geometric shapes of the body, creating 
a design alive with movement. 

HIGH-PERFORMANCE GLASS ROOF*
Key to the interior’s sense of light and 
space, the spectacular panoramic roof is 
engineered in a thermally efficient glass  
to keep you cool in summer and warm  
in winter. 
*    Selected grades only.
The All-New Toyota C-HR has been made to delight, 
the outstanding design is anything but ordinary.  
The stance is powerful, and the silhouette sleek.  
The striking bi-tone* body is complemented by  
20-inch wheels* and flush door handles, the expressive 
proportions are accentuated by the contrast execution.
ELEGANCE 
ON EVERY 
LEVEL 

A WELCOMING 
ENVIRONMENT
Feature-rich yet intuitive, the new Toyota C-HR offers a 
seamless and personalised experience that anticipates 
your needs. Turn drives into experiences with wireless 
Android Auto™ and Apple CarPlay, responsive ambient 
lighting*, and immersive surround sound*.
WELCOME BACK
The seamless digital experience begins 
before you even get behind the wheel, with 
a welcome scenario that plays out in light 
as you approach.
Apple CarPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc.
*    Selected grades only
*    Image shows 12.3” screen and combimeter, 
available on Design grade upwards.

Image shows 12.3-inch touchscreen. Design grade upwards.
Ambient lighting Design grade upwards.
SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITY
The high-resolution 12.3-inch touchscreen, 
breathtaking in its clarity and responsive 
to your touch, allows for fast and intuitive 
access to your digital world.
*    Selected grades only.
Technology drives every aspect of the All-New Toyota 
C-HR, ever-present and empowering. It puts you in 
control thanks to the 12.3-inch* Combimeter, a truly 
digital cockpit customisable from four display modes. 
It turns drives into experiences with rich and immersive 
audio, powered by bespoke JBL® speakers*. The Toyota 
C-HR watches out for you, the ambient lighting* – 
linked to the car’s safety systems – turns red to warn  
of a potential collision.
DRIVEN BY 
TECHNOLOGY

A CHOICE OF 
HYBRID OR  
PLUG-IN HYBRID
The new Toyota C-HR offers a range of advanced 
powertrains to fit your lifestyle. Choose from  
smooth and responsive Hybrid power or a new Dual 
DNA Plug-in Hybrid, which fuses dynamic Hybrid 
performance with true EV capability.
PLUG-IN HYBRID
Powertrain – 2.0-litre PHEV
EV Range – 41 miles 
Performance – 223 hp 
Low emissions – 19 g/km CO₂
HYBRID
Powertrain – 1.8- & 2.0-litre HEV
Performance – 140 & 197 hp 
Low emissions – 105 g/km CO₂
All figures shown are provisional, 
pending final WLTP homologation.

There’s a Toyota C-HR to fit your lifestyle. Icon impresses 
with its clean look and high level of equipment, 
including LED lights and wireless Apple CarPlay and 
Android Auto™ connectivity.  
Design and Excel layer on the style and technology 
with machined alloy wheels, twin 12.3-inch screens, 
wireless phone charging and ambient cockpit lighting. 
Comprehensively equipped, GR SPORT pulses with 
energy.  
Premiere Edition, with its stunning Sulphur paint, full 
leather sports seats and JBL® audio, is the ultimate 
expression of this mould-breaking new crossover.

Servicing your Toyota 
Toyota Service Pricing means you will be sure  
to know the cost of your service up front. Expertly 
trained technicians using only genuine Toyota 
parts will carry out your service at one of over 200 
Authorised Toyota Service Centres. The technicians 
will advise you on the correct service for your  
car based on the car’s age, mileage and  
service history.
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
owners/servicing-and-aftercare/service-mot-
maintenance
Service Plans
Inflation-proof pricing with a monthly or one-
off payment plan means one less thing to worry 
about. With Toyota Service Plans the price you’re 
quoted is guaranteed for the duration of your plan. 
The service, parts and labour are all paid for either 
in monthly instalments or as a one-off payment at 
the beginning of your plan. 
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
owners/servicing-and-aftercare/service-mot-
maintenance
Toyota Price Repairs using Genuine Parts  
We offer transparent prices on a number of repair 
items for your Toyota giving you peace of mind 
when it comes to managing costs. Also don’t forget 
we only use genuine Toyota parts, all of which 
come with at least 12 months’ warranty (some  
even offer unlimited mileage warranties); and  
your car will always be dealt with by a trained 
Toyota technician. 
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
owners/parts-accessories/parts
MyT
Whether you’re a long-term owner or have recently 
taken delivery of a new Toyota, there are lots of 
reasons to join MyT. Packed with time-saving and 
convenient features, MyT ensures everything you 
need to manage your vehicle ownership is in one 
place. You’ll also gain access to My Rewards where 
you can enjoy great offers and discounts from 
big brands on everything from family days out to 
pampering as well as everyday deals. 
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
mytoyota or download the MyT app now available 
on iTunes® and Android. 
Toyota Accessories
Toyota accessories are designed and 
manufactured with the same care, quality and 
attention to detail as Toyota vehicles. Tailor-
made for your Toyota, they fit perfectly and add a 
personal touch of style, comfort and practicality. 
Also, because they’ve been tested under the 
most severe conditions, you can have complete 
confidence in their reliability and durability. 
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
owners/parts-accessories/parts
Toyota Roadside Assistance
When you buy a new Toyota you will automatically 
receive 12 months’ AA Roadside Assistance in  
the UK and Europe, free of charge. After the  
first year, you can renew this cover by calling  
0344 701 6201 or visiting www.toyota.co.uk/
owners/roadside-assistance/
Get up to 10 years/100,000 miles Toyota Warranty*
Every new Toyota comes with a 3 year manufacturer 
warranty followed by a 12 months/10,000 miles 
additional warranty, with every qualifying service.  
For more information visit https://www.toyota.
co.uk/owners/toyota-warranty
Corrosion Cover
The 12-year unlimited mileage cover protects  
against rust perforation affecting sheet metal  
body panels as a result of a manufacturing fault. 
This warranty can also be transferred to any future 
owner throughout the 12-year period.
Rust and Paint Cover
The 3-year unlimited mileage cover protects  
against defects and surface rust as a result  
of a manufacturing fault.
Toyota Business Centre
Our Toyota Business Centre network promises 
you sameday access to a business manager or 
dedicated sales executive. With business offers 
and interactive wholelife cost modelling tools 
which consider emissions, fuel economy, servicing, 
insurance and residual value data, our advisers 
can accurately compare tax costs against any 
competitor. Whenever servicing is due, we can 
offer fixed-price servicing, free local vehicle 
collection and delivery (with wash and vac).
Special offers, fixed-price fleet servicing, specialist 
fleet insurance, business daily hire, Toyota Fleet 
Financial Services, extended test drives and a 
dedicated Business Centre Network are just some 
of the services business customers can expect  
from Toyota.
For more information visit www.toyota.co.uk/
businesscustomers
Toyota Motor Insurance
Toyota Motor Insurance is available for Toyota 
owners at competitive premiums. To obtain  
details of the benefits included and to arrange  
a quotation, please contact your local Toyota 
Centre or call 0800 350 500. 
Flexible Finance from Toyota Financial Services 
All our plans offer easy budgeting and peace of 
mind, and AccessToyota brings these benefits 
together in one flexible package. 
Toyota Financial Services, Great Burgh,  
Burgh Heath, Epsom, Surrey, KT18 5UZ.
Finance subject to status to over 18s only. 
Indemnities may be required. Terms and  
conditions apply.
TFS is authorised and regulated by the  
Financial Conduct Authority.
OWNING YOUR TOYOTA C-HR

official Toyota Centre or visit https://www.toyota.co.uk/owners/
toyota-warranty
